fusions.name: Bitter on the Tip
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lance the Swelling
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions. A lancing thrust from up to 3.5 tiles away that deals 8 damage, uses up its afflictions and adds 0.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Poisoned Chalice
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead, for 9 seconds.

fusions.name: No Hide Proof
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 12% poison resistance.
